own_solution.law: Physical pendulum: T = 2 pi sqrt((L^2/12 + d^2)/(g d))

defect_reasons.other: T1D34 moves the pivot of the rod while it is described as swinging, and TFE49 revises the stated 0.3 m pivot position, so the reader must infer that the period asked is the one after the move; the natural reading gives the certified answer.

notes: Checked R answers: q = 18 cm, d = 0.12 m: 0.1344/1.176 = 0.114286, T = 2.1241 s; q = 20.5 cm, d = 0.095 m: T = 2.3391 s; q = 22 cm, d = 0.08 m: 0.1264/0.784 = 0.161224, T = 2.5229 s. All match. All shifted d stay positive (pivot still off-centre). Mass cancels as claimed. Minimal pairs T1443/T1D34 and TFD4F/TFE49 share 20.5 cm and differ only in attachment/timing; T7714 and TF2C6 are declared numeral-free controls.
